storyboard.onScreenText: Ask your restorer what system they use to prove the job.
storyboard.voiceover: When restoration work starts, the most important question is not just who is doing the work. It is how they prove what happened, what changed, and what comes next.

storyboard.onScreenText: After damage, clients need clarity — not another explanation later.
storyboard.voiceover: After water, mould, fire, or storm damage, clients are already under pressure. They need clear evidence, a clear scope, and a clear path forward, not scattered photos and repeated phone calls.

storyboard.onScreenText: RestoreAssist gives your restorer a stronger way to show the work.
storyboard.voiceover: Many tools capture one piece of the job. RestoreAssist is built around the restoration workflow, so the inspection, evidence, moisture findings, scope, and report stay connected.
